versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Onshape FeatureScript Generator skill.
- Generates FeatureScript code for custom CAD features and parametric dust fittings (wyes, elbows, adapters, crosses).
- Supports code generation, modification, debugging, and pattern-based libraries (enums, labels, shells, safe unions).
- Implements consistent patterns for Z-axis fitting layouts, wrapped labels, and robust body/shell operations.
- Guides on usage with triggers like "Onshape FS for X" and details key FeatureScript best practices.
